turns.event: The stream just went live.
turns.think: Rainy morning in game. Lean into the mood.

turns.after: She pans the camera over to the half-built freezer.

turns.event: The stream just went live.
turns.think: Last stream ended on a cliffhanger. Remind them.

args.text: Okay, we are back, and yes, Rook is still standing in the doorway of that weird yellow room. Tonight we find out if he walks out again.

turns.after: She zooms in on Rook at the gate.

turns.event: The stream just went live.

args.text: Welcome to the least glamorous stream of the week, because headquarters sent a mountain of forms. We file them, then we earn some fun.

turns.event: The stream just went live.

args.text: Brand new colony, brand new mistakes, let's go! Three colonists, one gate, and absolutely no plan yet.

turns.after: She starts reading the starting colonists' backstories out loud.

turns.event: The stream just went live.

args.text: Hey, hi, settle in, grab something warm to drink. We're doing a slow building night, nothing scary, I promise for once.

turns.after: She pulls up the architect menu.

turns.event: The stream just went live.
turns.think: Winter is coming in game. Set stakes.

args.text: We are live, and winter shows up in four days with zero warning from anyone. Tonight is all about food, heaters, and not panicking.

turns.after: She checks the food stockpile count.

turns.event: The stream just went live.
turns.think: Promised a contract run. Hype it.

args.text: Hello, hello, I promised you a contract run and I keep my promises. Odessa and Pip are packed and staring at the gate like it owes them money.

turns.after: She drags the expedition window open.

turns.event: The stream just went live.
turns.think: Late start. Own it with a joke.

args.text: Yes, I'm twelve minutes late, the kettle and I had a disagreement. [laughter] Anyway, tonight we finish the research bench.

turns.after: She queues the research bench build.

turns.event: The stream just went live.
turns.think: Challenge run starts today. Explain briefly.

args.text: Welcome in, because today the challenge starts, no expeditions until we hit fifty days. Pure base building, pure suffering, in a cozy way.

turns.after: She sets a note on screen for the day counter.

turns.event: The stream just went live.
turns.think: Fun opener. Sounds like a weather report.

args.text: Good evening, here is your colony forecast, light rain, heavy chaos, and a slight chance of the gate spitting out something odd. Stay tuned.

turns.after: She centers the camera on the gate room.

turns.event: The stream just went live.

args.text: So, last time a fire took half the kitchen, and we're not talking about it. Tonight is the rebuild, brick by brick.

turns.after: She marks the burned walls for deconstruction.

turns.event: The stream just went live.
turns.think: Viewer suggestion night. Explain the plan.

args.text: We're live, and tonight chat picks the names for every new animal we tame. Keep them kind and keep them silly.

turns.after: She checks the animals tab for wild ones nearby.

turns.event: The stream just went live.
turns.think: Hollis joined last stream. Feature him.

args.text: Hi everyone, tonight is all about Hollis, our newest colonist, who has never held a hammer in his life. We are fixing that.

turns.event: The stream just went live.

args.text: We're live and headquarters is sending an inspector today, act natural, everybody! Hide the pile of unfinished paperwork.

turns.after: She scrolls the alert about the inspection.

turns.event: The stream just went live.
turns.think: Short stream tonight. Say so upfront.

args.text: Heads up, chat, short one tonight, about ninety minutes. We get the solar panels up and call it a win.

turns.event: The stream just went live.

args.text: Happy Monday, which is a sentence nobody believes. Let's make it better by building Ivy the nicest bedroom this colony has ever seen.

turns.after: She opens the room stats overlay.

turns.event: The stream just went live.
turns.think: Expedition gone wrong last time. Address recovery.

args.text: Hey friends, we left Bram lost somewhere past the gate last time. First job tonight is getting him home in one piece.

turns.event: The stream just went live.
turns.think: Anniversary of the colony in game. Celebrate.

args.text: Welcome back, and it's the colony's first birthday in game! We are throwing a party, and Tamsin is in charge of the cake.

turns.after: She schedules a party for the evening.

args.text: Lilac, first in the door, you get the good chair! Welcome in.

turns.think: Regular who's usually late. Tease gently.

args.text: Cobalt, early? I need to sit down. [laughter] Glad you're here for the start of it.
Quietfern and Pebble, hello you two, you caught the stream before anything's on fire.

turns.after: She clicks over to the stockpile.

chat.msg: just got off work, perfect timing

turns.think: Viewer tired after work. Welcome them to unwind.

args.text: Then this is your spot to unwind, Dustmote. Nothing to do here but watch colonists make questionable choices.

turns.after: She sends Pip to haul some steel.

chat.msg: am i the only one here lol

turns.think: Just one viewer so far. Make them feel special.

args.text: Right now it's just you and me, which honestly makes this a private tour. Welcome, Moss.

turns.after: She narrates what each colonist is doing.

turns.think: New viewer. Welcome them without overwhelming.

args.text: Oh welcome, Brightkettle! You picked a good night, we're just getting started so you won't miss a thing.

turns.after: She gives a one-line tour of the base.

turns.after: She zooms in on a dozing Scar.

args.text: Early squad, I see you, and you get front row seats to the first gate run of the night!

turns.think: Viewer in a different time zone. Note it kindly.

args.text: Good morning to you then, Sablewren, evening here, so we meet in the middle. Thanks for starting your day with us.

turns.after: She returns to the build queue.

args.text: Not much yet, Tidepool, just me and a pile of wood that wants to be a wall. Welcome in.
Hazel brought snacks, everyone else, take notes. Pass some to the colonists, they're starving.
Hi Glimmer, watching from the bus is dedication. Hope it's a smooth ride.

chat.msg: arrived before the raid this time

args.text: Bold of you to assume there's a raid tonight, Nimbus. [laughter] Okay, there's probably a raid.
Hey hey to you, Copperwolf, pull up a crate.
Love that energy, Marigold, we need it, Juno is about to try cooking!

turns.after: She watches Juno walk to the stove.

args.text: Welcome, Fernlight. Short version, we built a freezer, Pip tripped twice, and the gate is quiet for now.

Welcome in, Rustbucket. We sent Odessa and Rook through the gate about twenty minutes ago. They found a room that's all hallways and humming lights. Rook picked up a strange brass key and we don't know what it opens. Now we're waiting to see if they make it back before nightfall.
Hi Orchid, situation is bad but fixable. A cold snap hit, the heaters are out, and Mara is rewiring them as fast as she can.

turns.after: She follows Mara to the power room.

args.text: Sure thing, Kitecloud. We finished the new barracks, and everyone has their own bed for once. Ivy got a mood boost and celebrated by doing absolutely nothing. Now we're planning the next contract.

turns.after: She zooms on the scorched chair spot.

chat.msg: just tuned in, why is everyone in the freezer

args.text: Great question, Ember. It's a heat wave, the freezer is the only cool room, and everyone decided it's their bedroom now.
Pip got hurt by something strange in the gate about an hour ago. He's resting in bed and Tamsin is patching him up. He's going to be okay, he just needs time.

chat.msg: hi just arrived from my class

turns.think: Viewer from class, catch-up and welcome.

args.text: Welcome from class, Bluebell. We've been quietly building a greenhouse, so you didn't miss any chaos yet. Perfect timing for the fun part.

turns.think: New arrival asks about artifact. Explain.

args.text: Oh, that glowing thing came back with Juno from the gate. It hums at night and we have no idea what it does. Research says three more days to figure it out.

turns.think: Joking but nobody died. Reassure with humor.

args.text: Nobody died, Frostbyte, despite everyone's best efforts. [laughter] Hollis just tried to wrestle a turkey and lost.

chat.msg: just got here, why are there so many forms

args.text: Ah, the forms. Headquarters sends paperwork after every expedition, and if we ignore it, they cut our supply drops. So we file, we sigh, and we file again.

turns.after: She assigns Odessa to the desk.

chat.msg: hey everyone, what did the gate spit out

args.text: So, Crowfeather, the gate opened by itself about ten minutes ago. Out walked a stranger in an office uniform who won't say a word. We gave her a bed and some food. She just stares at the gate, and honestly, same.

turns.after: She checks the stranger's info card.

chat.msg: back after dinner, did i miss the boss fight

args.text: You missed it, Spindle, but it went great. Scar held the door, Ivy kept everyone patched, and we only lost one window.

turns.after: She points out the broken window.

chat.msg: just arrived. why is the colony so quiet

args.text: It's three in the morning in game, Tinsel, so everybody's asleep except Rook on watch. We're letting the night pass before the next run.

chat.msg: what's the deal with the gate

args.text: The gate is the heart of this whole run, Cindergrove. It opens into strange rooms that go on forever. We send colonists in for loot and contracts from a company called Async Industries. Sometimes they come back with treasure, sometimes with stories. Sometimes both.

turns.after: She zooms in on the gate frame.

args.text: That was me, Dewdrop, a boomalope wandered into the kitchen. It's handled, nobody exploded, the soup survived.
Good news, Mothwing, the inspector gave us a passing grade. Bad news, she wants the bathrooms cleaner. So the next hour is cleaning.
Mara had a rough moment, Juniper, too much darkness in the gate rooms. She's resting by the fire with a fresh meal. I'm keeping her off expeditions for a few days.

turns.event: The streamer is stepping away for a short break.

args.text: Quick five minute break, chat, stretch, drink some water, and keep an eye on Bram for me.

turns.after: She switches the overlay to the break screen.

turns.event: The break screen just came up.
turns.think: Break, joke about colonists left alone.

args.text: Stepping away for a few minutes, and the colony is on its own. If anything burns, it's your fault for not warning me. [laughter]

turns.event: The streamer is back from a break.

args.text: I'm back, I'm hydrated, and I see nobody set anything on fire. Proud of you all.
Thanks, Owlbear, missed you all for a solid four minutes.

turns.after: She checks what changed while paused.

turns.event: The streamer is stepping away for a ten minute break.
turns.think: Longer break, give something to do.

args.text: Ten minute break, friends. While I'm gone, chat about what we should name the new dog.

turns.event: The streamer is back from a break.

args.text: Back, and I made tea that is way too hot to drink, so I'll just hold it like a trophy.

chat.msg: what did we name the dog

turns.think: Returned from break; chat named the dog.

args.text: Chat decided while I was gone, Pebble, the dog is officially Biscuit. Welcome to the family, Biscuit.

turns.after: She renames the dog in the animals tab.

turns.event: The streamer is stepping away briefly.
turns.think: Quick bathroom break, keep it light.

args.text: Two minutes, be right back. The game is paused so nobody gets eaten.

turns.after: She switches to the break screen.

turns.event: The streamer is back from a break.

args.text: And we're back, thank you for waiting, I can see the chat stayed lovely.

turns.event: The streamer is stepping away to grab dinner.

args.text: Okay, dinner break, fifteen minutes, and yes, I'm eating better than Pip ever will. Back soon.

turns.after: She puts on the break music.

turns.event: The streamer is back from a dinner break.

args.text: Fed and ready, chat. Where were we, oh right, the freezer has no door.

turns.event: The streamer is stepping away; the break overlay is showing.

args.text: Short break, and your homework is to guess how many days until Rook gets hungry again. Winner gets bragging rights.

turns.event: The streamer is back from a break.

args.text: Back, and the answer was two days, Rook eats like a black hole! Nobody guessed that low.

turns.event: The streamer is back from a break but the game was left unpaused.

args.text: I forgot to pause and Tamsin built a whole extra room while I was gone! Honestly, give her a raise.

args.text: Rook made it, believers, you get the points! Doubters, I'm sorry, he's tougher than he looks.

args.text: Do we finish the freezer before winter hits?

turns.event: The prediction resolved: the freezer was not done before winter. Doubters won.

args.text: Doubters win, the freezer missed winter by half a day. [laughter] I have learned nothing.

args.text: Research poll, chat, electricity, better beds, or gate shielding, pick our future.

turns.event: The poll ended: Gate shielding 48%, Electricity 46%, Better beds 6%.

args.text: Gate shielding wins by two percent, that was close! Sorry, better beds, six percent is rough.

args.text: Sixty percent of you think Hollis lasts one day, that's cold. Hollis, prove them wrong.

args.text: Raid incoming, prediction is open, does the south wall hold?

args.text: The wall held! Everyone who believed in the south wall, enjoy your points.

args.text: Of course you picked mystery meat, sixty five percent of you. [laughter] Tamsin, I'm so sorry.

args.text: Big one, chat, do we build a second gate room?

args.text: Eighty one percent yes, you want chaos, and you'll get it. Second gate room, here we go.
